title: Golden visa
text: The UAE Government Portal describes the Golden visa as long-term residence for eligible foreign talent. It lists groups including investors, entrepreneurs, scientists, exceptional talent, outstanding students and graduates, humanitarian pioneers and frontline heroes. Depending on category, residence can be five or ten years and does not require a sponsor.

title: Golden visa
text: Golden visa benefits described by the federal portal include renewable long-term residence, no sponsor requirement, extended ability to remain outside the UAE, and sponsorship of family members. Eligibility requirements vary by category and should be checked in the official source.

title: Residence visa for studying in the UAE
text: The federal portal says a student may reside in the UAE under sponsorship of a resident parent or an accredited university or college. Universities can facilitate the visa process. The page also points to Golden visa arrangements for outstanding students.

title: Types of visas
text: The UAE Government Portal residence-visa index links users to information about Golden, visit, work, residence, student, investor, tourist, transit, medical and Blue visas. It acts as a federal navigation page rather than an emirate-specific driving service.

title: Apply for or Manage a Driving Licence — Renew Driving Licence
text: Dubai RTA's driving-licence renewal service instructs applicants to complete the required eye test, log in using accepted identity or UAE Pass details, choose driving-licence renewal, confirm licence details, choose a delivery method, and pay applicable fines and fees. A digital licence can be issued through RTA channels.

title: Apply for or Manage a Driving Licence — Renew Driving Licence
text: For Dubai driving-licence renewal, the RTA service page describes different validity periods depending on age and whether the holder is a UAE or GCC citizen or a resident. Users should rely on the current RTA service page for their exact category.

title: Renew and Amend Vehicle Data Ownership
text: Dubai RTA's vehicle ownership renewal flow checks valid vehicle insurance and technical inspection where applicable, then takes payment and issues the vehicle ownership certificate through supported digital, kiosk or delivery channels. The service concerns vehicles registered in Dubai.

title: Renew and Amend Vehicle Data Ownership
text: The RTA service is for renewing or amending ownership data for a Dubai-registered vehicle and can also cover replacement of a lost or damaged ownership certificate. The official page describes a renewed vehicle ownership output valid for one year.

title: Obtain Driving Licence
text: TAMM's Abu Dhabi Obtain Driving Licence life event groups services such as opening a traffic file, arranging theory or practical test steps, eye examination, practical training and obtaining the driving licence. Individual services are attributed to Abu Dhabi Police or the Integrated Transport Centre.

title: قيادة المركبات والمواصلات
text: تجمع منصة تم في أبوظبي خدمات قيادة المركبات والمواصلات ضمن فئات تشمل إدارة رخصة القيادة، إدارة المركبة الشخصية، الحصول على رخصة القيادة، الغرامات والمخالفات، المواقف، درب ولوحات المركبات.

title: خدمات ترخيص السائقين والمركبات
text: تتضمن بوابة الخدمات العامة لهيئة الطرق والمواصلات في دبي خدمات ترخيص السائقين والمركبات مثل تجديد رخصة القيادة، استبدال الرخصة التالفة أو المفقودة، وتجديد المركبة وخدمات اللوحات والمخالفات.
